q23387.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T goes through first.

explain.short: T is a tram. With no signs, vehicles on rails have priority, so the tram goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: the tram T opens the order.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: the tram T goes first

q23388.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes through right after vehicle T.

explain.short: After the tram, A goes straight on. S turns left and must let A pass, so A is second.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'subito dopo' (right after) is right: A comes just after the tram.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: A goes right after the tram T

q23389.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle S must wait for vehicles T and A to go through.

explain.short: S must wait for the tram (priority on rails) and for A (S turns left, A comes straight from the opposite side).
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is right: S waits for both T and A.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: S waits for T and A

q23390.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: T, A, S.

explain.short: Tram first, then A going straight, then S turning left. This is the full correct order.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; T, A, S is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T, A, S

q23391.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes through first.

explain.short: A cannot go first: the tram T has priority over vehicles without rails. A goes second.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: the tram goes first, A only after it.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the tram T goes first, A is second

q23392.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: A, T, S.

explain.short: The order starts with A, but the tram T has priority and must go first. Correct order: T, A, S.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'A, T, S' swaps the first two: the tram is before A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is T, A, S, not A, T, S

q23393.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle S goes through after vehicle T, but before vehicle A.

explain.short: S turns left, so it must let A (coming straight from the opposite side) pass first. S is last, after A.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'ma prima del veicolo A' (but before A) is wrong: S goes after A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: S goes after A, not before

q23394.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicles A and S go through at the same time after vehicle T has passed.

explain.short: A and S cannot go together: S turns left across A's path, so it must wait for A.
explain.rule: With no signs or officer, the tram (on rails) goes first. A driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: their paths cross, so S waits.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A and S do not go together - S waits for A

q23395.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle B must wait for vehicle P to go through.

explain.short: P comes from B's right, so B must give way to P.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is right: P is on B's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: B waits for P on its right

q23396.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle P goes through first.

explain.short: P has nobody on its right, so it does not have to give way to anyone. It goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: P has its right free.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: P goes first (right side free)

q23397.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in the order: P, B, C.

explain.short: P has its right free; B has P on its right; C has B on its right. So P, B, C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'nell'ordine' (in the order): check each letter; P, B, C is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: P, B, C

q23398.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C has its right side occupied.

explain.short: B is on C's right, so C's right is 'occupied' and C must give way to B.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'destra occupata' (right side occupied) means someone is on your right: here it is B.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: B is on C's right

q23399.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle B goes through last.

explain.short: B goes second, not last. C has B on its right, so C is the last one.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: the last one is C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B is second, C goes last

q23400.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in the order: P, C, B.

explain.short: C cannot go before B: B is on C's right. The correct order is P, B, C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'P, C, B' swaps the last two: C waits for B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is P, B, C, not P, C, B

q23401.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicles P and C go through at the same time.

explain.short: P and C do not go together: P goes first, but C must wait for B, which waits for P. C is last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: C goes last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes first, C goes last

q23402.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle P enters the junction first but must stop in the middle of it.

explain.short: P goes first and crosses the junction without stopping: nobody has priority over it.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your right (precedenza a destra). P has nobody on its right, so it goes first.
explain.trap: 'si deve fermare al centro' (must stop in the middle) is wrong: P goes straight through its turn.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes first and does not stop

q23403.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B goes through first.

explain.short: B has nobody on its right, so it gives way to no one and goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: B has its right free.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: B goes first (right side free)

q23404.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles go through in this order: B, T, S.

explain.short: B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right. So B, T, S.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; B, T, S is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: B, T, S

q23405.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle S goes through last.

explain.short: S has T on its right, and T waits for B. So S is the last one.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: S waits for both T and B.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: S goes last

q23406.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles go through in this order: S, B, T.

explain.short: S cannot go first: T is on its right. The correct order is B, T, S.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'S, B, T' puts S first, but S is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is B, T, S, not S, B, T

q23407.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B must give way to vehicle T.

explain.short: It is the opposite: B is on T's right, so T gives way to B.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'B deve dare la precedenza a T' turns the rule around: T must give way to B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: T gives way to B, not B to T

q23408.en: At the junction shown in the picture, none of the vehicles has to slow down.

explain.short: At every junction all drivers must slow down (moderare la velocità) and be ready to give way, even the one who goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'nessuno' (none) is wrong: everyone must slow down near a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: all must slow down at a junction

q23409.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicles B and S go through at the same time.

explain.short: B goes first, but S must wait for T, which is on its right. S goes last, not together with B.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. B has its right free; T has B on its right; S has T on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: T goes between B and S.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B first, then T, then S

q23410.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A goes through after vehicle R.

explain.short: R comes from A's right, so A must wait for R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo R' (after R) is right: R is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: A goes after R

q23411.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: R has nobody on its right, so it gives way to no one and goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' (gives way to no vehicle) is right for R.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: R gives way to no one

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23412.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: A comes from C's right, so C must give way to A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'C deve dare la precedenza al veicolo A' is right: A is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: C gives way to A on its right

q23413.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in this order: R, A, C.

explain.short: R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right. So R, A, C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; R, A, C is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: R, A, C

q23414.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: C has A on its right, so it must give way to A. C is the last one.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' is wrong for C: that is true only for R.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C must give way to A

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23415.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicles R and C go through at the same time.

explain.short: R goes first, but C must wait for A, which is on its right. C is last, not together with R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: A goes between R and C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R first, then A, then C

q23416.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in this order: R, C, A.

explain.short: C cannot go before A: A is on C's right. The correct order is R, A, C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'R, C, A' swaps the last two: C waits for A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, A, C, not R, C, A

q23417.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R must wait for vehicles C and A to go through.

explain.short: R has its right free and goes first. It is C and A that wait for R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. R has its right free; A has R on its right; C has A on its right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: R waits for nobody.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes first, the others wait

q23418.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles clear the junction in this order: H, D, B.

explain.short: H turns right without crossing anyone and goes first. D has H on its right. B turns left and waits for D. So H, D, B.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'disimpegnano' (clear, leave) the junction: the order H, D, B is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: H, D, B

q23419.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B must go through last.

explain.short: B turns left, so it must let D (coming straight from the opposite side) pass. D waits for H. So B is last.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: the left-turning B waits for everyone.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: B, turning left, goes last

q23420.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle H does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: H turns right close to the corner and does not cross anyone's path. B turns left and must wait anyway. So H gives way to no one.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' (gives way to no vehicle) is right for H.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: H turns right and gives way to no one

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23421.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle D must give way to vehicle H.

explain.short: H comes from D's right, so D must give way to H.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'D deve dare la precedenza al veicolo H' is right: H is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: D gives way to H on its right

q23422.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle D must wait until vehicle B has gone through.

explain.short: It is the opposite: B turns left, so B waits for D, which comes straight from the opposite side.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'D deve attendere ... B' turns the rule around: B waits for D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B waits for D, not D for B

q23423.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles clear the junction in this order: H, B, D.

explain.short: B cannot go before D: B turns left and must let D pass. The correct order is H, D, B.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'H, B, D' swaps the last two: B waits for D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is H, D, B, not H, B, D

q23424.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B has priority over vehicle D.

explain.short: B turns left, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic going straight. So D has priority over B.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is the wrong way round: D has priority over B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D has priority over B

q23425.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicles H and B can go through at the same time.

explain.short: B must wait for D, and D waits for H. So B goes last, not together with H.
explain.rule: Give way to the right, and a driver turning left gives way to oncoming traffic. H turns right close to the corner and crosses no one's path.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: D goes between H and B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: H first, then D, then B

q23426.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle P can go through first.

explain.short: P turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path. So it can go first.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'può passare per primo' (can go first) is right: P's right turn blocks no one.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: P turns right and can go first

q23427.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle D must give way to vehicle P.

explain.short: P comes from D's right, so D must give way to P.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'D deve dare la precedenza al veicolo P' is right: P is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: D gives way to P on its right

q23428.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B must wait until vehicles P and D have gone through.

explain.short: B has D on its right, and D waits for P. So B goes after both P and D.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is right: B waits for P and D.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: B waits for P and D

q23429.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L must give way to vehicle B.

explain.short: B comes from L's right, so L must give way to B.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'L deve dare la precedenza al veicolo B' is right: B is on L's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: L gives way to B on its right

q23430.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: P, D, B, L.

explain.short: P turns right and goes first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right: D, then B, then L.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; P, D, B, L is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: P, D, B, L

q23431.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B must give way to vehicle L.

explain.short: It is the opposite: B is on L's right, so L gives way to B.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'B deve dare la precedenza al veicolo L' turns the rule around: L gives way to B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L gives way to B, not B to L

q23432.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle P must wait for the other three vehicles to go through.

explain.short: P turns right without crossing anyone, so it goes first. It does not wait for the others.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: P is the first, not the last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes first, it waits for no one

q23433.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: P, D, L, B.

explain.short: L cannot go before B: B is on L's right. The correct order is P, D, B, L.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'P, D, L, B' swaps the last two: L waits for B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is P, D, B, L, not P, D, L, B

q23434.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicles D and L go through together first.

explain.short: P goes first. D goes second, and L is the very last one. They do not go together.
explain.rule: Give way to vehicles from your right. P turns right close to the corner and crosses no one, so it can go first; then each one waits for the vehicle on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente per primi' (together, first) is wrong twice: P is first, and L is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes first, L goes last

q23435.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E goes through first.

explain.short: E turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so it goes first.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: E's right turn blocks no one.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: E turns right and goes first

q23436.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C goes through after vehicle E.

explain.short: E goes first. C turns left after E has passed, and before M, which has C on its right.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo E' (after E) is right: C is second.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: C goes after E

q23437.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: E, C, M.

explain.short: E turns right and goes first; C goes next; M has C on its right and goes last. So E, C, M.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; E, C, M is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: E, C, M

q23438.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle M goes through first.

explain.short: M has C on its right, so it must give way to C. M goes last, not first.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: M is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: M goes last, E goes first

q23439.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: C, M and E.

explain.short: E is first, not last: its right turn crosses no one. The correct order is E, C, M.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'C, M ed E' puts E last, but E goes first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is E, C, M, not C, M, E

q23440.en: Having to cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicles M and E go through at the same time.

explain.short: E goes first, but M must wait for C, which is on its right. So M goes last, not together with E.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so E goes first. Then give way to the right: M has C on its right, so C goes before M.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: C goes between E and M.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E first, then C, then M

q23441.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes through first.

explain.short: A turns right close to the corner and crosses nobody's path, so it goes first.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right: A's right turn blocks no one.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: A turns right and goes first

q23442.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: A comes from C's right, so C must give way to A.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'C deve dare la precedenza al veicolo A' is right: A is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: C gives way to A on its right

q23443.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L goes through last.

explain.short: L turns left, so it must let C (coming straight from the opposite side) pass. C waits for A. So L is last.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is right: the left-turning L waits for everyone.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: L, turning left, goes last

q23444.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: A, C, L.

explain.short: A turns right and goes first; C has A on its right; L turns left and waits for C. So A, C, L.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): check each letter; A, C, L is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: A, C, L

q23445.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A must wait for vehicles L and C to go through.

explain.short: A turns right without crossing anyone and goes first. It is C and L that wait.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: A waits for nobody.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes first, the others wait

q23446.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L goes through first.

explain.short: L turns left, so it must let C (coming straight from the opposite side) pass. L goes last, not first.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: L is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L goes last, A goes first

q23447.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: L, C, A.

explain.short: This is the order backwards. The correct order is A, C, L.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'L, C, A' turns the order upside down: A is first, L is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is A, C, L, not L, C, A

q23448.en: Arriving at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C must wait for vehicle L to go through.

explain.short: It is the opposite: L turns left, so L waits for C, which comes straight from the opposite side.
explain.rule: A right turn close to the corner crosses no one, so A goes first. C has A on its right. L turns left, so it gives way to C coming straight from the opposite side.
explain.trap: 'C deve attendere ... L' turns the rule around: L waits for C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L waits for C, not C for L

q23449.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: E has nobody on its right, so it gives way to no one and goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' (gives way to no vehicle) is right for E.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: E gives way to no one

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23450.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C must give way to vehicle E.

explain.short: E comes from C's right, so C must give way to E.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'C deve dare la precedenza al veicolo E' is right: E is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: C gives way to E on its right

q23451.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L must wait for vehicles E and C to go through.

explain.short: L has C on its right, and C waits for E. So L goes after both E and C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is right: L waits for E and C.

sceneParams.caption: Correct: L waits for E and C

q23452.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles clear the junction in this order: E, C, L.

explain.short: E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right. So E, C, L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'disimpegnano' (clear, leave) the junction: the order E, C, L is right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: E, C, L

q23453.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C must wait for vehicle L to go through.

explain.short: It is the opposite: C is on L's right, so L waits for C.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'C deve attendere ... L' turns the rule around: L waits for C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L waits for C, not C for L

q23454.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E must go through last.

explain.short: E has its right free and goes first, not last. L is the last one.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: E is the first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E goes first, L goes last

q23455.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles clear the junction in this order: E, L, C.

explain.short: L cannot go before C: C is on L's right. The correct order is E, C, L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'E, L, C' swaps the last two: L waits for C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is E, C, L, not E, L, C

q23456.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicles C and E go through at the same time.

explain.short: E is on C's right, so C must wait for E. They do not go together.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles from your right. E has its right free; C has E on its right; L has C on its right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: C waits for E.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E goes first, then C

keywords.en: go through at the same time
